learning_outcomes.text: Explain the SIEM/SOAR model and Sentinel architecture
Connect data sources and manage the Log Analytics workspace
Write KQL for detection and investigation
Build analytics rules that create incidents
Investigate and manage incidents and entities
Automate response with playbooks and SOAR

integrative_case: A SOC onboards Sentinel for a mid-size firm. Connect identity, endpoint and cloud logs to a central workspace, write KQL detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, create analytics rules that raise incidents, build an investigation workflow with entities and a timeline, and automate containment with a playbook, then defend the detection coverage.
